implementation_freeze_head_statement: Because a commit cannot self-reference, the exact SHA is captured from the current clean HEAD in the persisted STARTED journal immediately before formal cell #1.

lifecycle_gate.historical_gate_statement: D4 requires the D3.5 bridge validated by A2; D3.5-A2 alone validated the replacement.
lifecycle_gate.evidence_basis: D3_COMPLETE + D3_5_SELECTIVITY_VALIDATED + D3_5_A6_DOWNSTREAM_ADMISSION_VALIDATED. Historical D3.5-A2 observed the structured bridge mechanism at candidate-pool level (+0.3 combined candidate recall), but produced zero incremental final-evidence recovery due to downstream cutoff. D3.5-A5-R2 repaired and validated deterministic candidate selectivity (v2 policy, 4/8 caps, relevant evidence retained). D3.5-A6 Phase 2 validated bounded reserved rerank admission (K=3) at downstream final-evidence level under Gemini 3.8 Flash, achieving CAUSAL_DELTA_3 = 2 (3/3 stable reserved witness on g036.e1 and g021.e1) with REGRESSION_3 = 0 across 5 safety groups. Validated for bounded development migration only; PRODUCTION_ACTIVATION remains false.

replacement_authority.d1_d2_authority: D2 governed resolution -> D1 accepted objects/relations/workflows. No fuzzy/dense/LLM jumping.
replacement_authority.bridge_semantics: Bounded reachability: max 1 upward containment transition + max 1 predicate/type-gated relation/workflow transition. Governed provenance materialization to exact source/version evidence.
replacement_authority.eligible_payload_source: complete normalized object lookup including pre-cap ranked-out candidates
replacement_authority.post_rerank_fallback_pool: treatment pool [*reranked, *rerank_pool, *baseline_fused_ordering] to preserve reserved candidates
prohibited_shortcuts: No new scorer, weights, or reranker models
No benchmark-specific mapping tables or ID lookup dicts
No silent re-injection of suppressed legacy locators into retrieval channels

LEGACY_CONTROL.description: Current query-expansion behavior without suppression and without D4 replacement path.

BATCH1_ABLATION.description: Batch-1 fixed-location components suppressed; no structured replacement path.

BATCH1_REPLACEMENT.description: Batch-1 fixed-location components suppressed; validated generic structured replacement active with K=3 bounded rerank admission.

safety_definition.safety_population_rule: Evidence groups with stable final-evidence retention under LEGACY_CONTROL across the frozen A6 safety evidence groups
safety_definition.regression_criterion: Zero material control regressions under replacement across safety population (REGRESSION_REPLACEMENT == 0); REGRESSION_ABLATION is diagnostic and non-gating

verdict_precedence: 1. Structural or protocol/treatment construction violation -> INVALID / PROTOCOL_OR_TREATMENT_CONSTRUCTION_FAILED
2. Material control regression on any group in safety population under replacement (REGRESSION_REPLACEMENT > 0) -> FAIL / MATERIAL_SAFETY_REGRESSION
3. Both target rules REPLACEMENT_VALIDATED with reserved admission witness and zero replacement regression -> PASS / FIRST_BATCH_FIXED_LOCATOR_REPLACEMENT_VALIDATED_FOR_DEVELOPMENT
4. Exactly one target rule REPLACEMENT_VALIDATED -> PARTIAL / MIXED_TARGET_REPLACEMENT_EVIDENCE
5. At least one target rule LEGACY_DEPENDENCY_NOT_REPRODUCED -> PARTIAL / LEGACY_DEPENDENCY_NOT_REPRODUCED_IN_CURRENT_PROTOTYPE
6. At least one target rule REPLACEMENT_FAILED -> FAIL / FIXED_LOCATOR_REPLACEMENT_DID_NOT_RECOVER_CONFIRMED_DEPENDENCY
7. Both target rules LEGACY_CONTROL_REFERENCE_NOT_REPRODUCED -> INCONCLUSIVE / LEGACY_CONTROL_REFERENCE_NOT_REPRODUCED

n022.description: Evaluated for non-trigger stability and potential structured generalization; does not gate PASS/FAIL.

resume_and_failure_semantics.execution_order: case-major: for each case in cases (g036, g021, n006, g041, g020, n004, n022), execute LEGACY_CONTROL, then BATCH1_ABLATION, then BATCH1_REPLACEMENT
rules: Before each slot invocation, state transitions to STARTED and is flushed to disk
On successful slot completion, state transitions to COMPLETED and is flushed to disk
On slot error, state transitions to FAILED, is flushed to disk, and execution terminates immediately
COMPLETED slots are never rerun on resumption
An ambiguous STARTED or FAILED slot halts execution immediately
